email.subject: Fast Lane Auto Care: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Fast Lane Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you calls:

There's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors searching for auto care in Harbor Falls have to copy and dial manually -- most won't bother, they'll just call the next shop.

The footer also still shows outdated info, which makes the site look unmaintained and can make people second-guess whether you're still open.

I fix issues like these for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I'd change and why? No obligation.

Alex
